rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site aggregated from four databases (local Beijing recruitment, FCON-1000, devCCNP, Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "data from 849 healthy children were sourced from four databases: (i) 61 were locally recruited in Beijing; (ii) 69 from the fcon_1000 projects dataset; (iii) 450 from the Child Connectome Project (devCCNP) 27 ; (iv) 269 from the Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center."
